I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random: the ticket is **PD-4821**.

Hollis mentioned it in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026, and Tobias is a member of that channel. The ticket has the Eastbank receiving-door import for Marrow Agrisupply attached. At the time, the file labelled doors E1/E2 but their booking sheet used 01/02, and that needed sorting before anyone reimported. I didn't see any later update on the ticket.

A ticket number is an operational fact, so no approval was needed to share it.
